memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels. Then he asked, 'Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?' She answered him, 'I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor.' And she added, 'We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night.' Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD, saying, 'Praise be to the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master's relatives.'" - Gen 24:22-27 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
When the servant learns that this kind young woman belongs to Abraham's own family, his first response is not celebration but worship. Right there beside the well, he bows down and praises God. He does not congratulate himself for a clever plan or good luck. He gives all the credit to the Lord's kindness and faithfulness.

Notice his words: God "has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness." The servant sees this moment as one more link in a long chain of God's steady care. He recognises God's hand not only in the big miracles but in the quiet leading of an ordinary journey — "the LORD has led me."

How quick are we to explain away God's goodness as coincidence? The servant trains our eyes to see God in the details and to respond with thankfulness. When something goes well, our first instinct can be worship rather than pride.

Take a moment today to look back over your week. Where has God quietly led you, provided for you, or protected you? Do not let those mercies pass unnoticed. Bow your heart and say, "Praise be to the Lord."

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When things go well, is my first response worship or pride?
2. Where has God quietly led me this week?
3. Am I noticing God's hand in the everyday details?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You are kind and faithful, and You lead me even when I do not notice. Teach me to pause and worship You for Your goodness in the small things. Amen.
